summary: CPU feature/probing helper. Toggles the EFLAGS ID bit (0x200000) via __writeeflags/__readeflags to detect CPUID support; if the bit flips, CPUID is available. When RDTSC support is present (CPUID leaf 1 EDX bit 0x10), computes the elapsed TSC since the 64-bit base stored in *a1 (high dword) and *a2 (low dword), writing the delta back into those same two dwords. If a3 is non-null, fills a3 with the CPU vendor string from CPUID leaf 0 (EBX/EDX/ECX, 12 bytes, NUL-terminated at +12). Always returns 0.

operations.description: CPUID-support probe: toggle EFLAGS bit 0x200000 (ID flag) with __writeeflags and read it back; if v4 != v3 the bit flipped and CPUID is present, otherwise the function skips all CPUID work.
Issue CPUID leaf 1 (EAX=1) and test EDX bit 0x10 (0x10) to check RDTSC support.
Compute elapsed TSC as v11 = __rdtsc() - __PAIR64__(*a1, *a2), i.e. current counter minus the 64-bit base formed from the two stored dwords.
Store the elapsed TSC delta back into the caller's dword pair: *a1 = high dword (HIDWORD), *a2 = low dword (v11).
Guard on a3 being non-null; the vendor-string write happens only when a buffer is supplied.
Issue CPUID leaf 0 (EAX=0) and write the vendor string: *(a3) = EBX, *(a3+4) = EDX, *(a3+8) = ECX, then NUL-terminate the 12-byte string at *(a3+12).
Issue CPUID leaf 1 (EAX=1) a second time (final flush of the CPUID sequence).
